alternatives.name: Fix TypeGuard to narrow in both branches
alternatives.description: Modify the existing TypeGuard (PEP 647) to also narrow the type in the else branch instead of introducing a new form.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Changing TypeGuard's semantics would break existing code that relies on the current one-sided narrowing behavior. A new form (TypeIs) with stricter requirements is safer.

alternatives.name: Add a flag to TypeGuard
alternatives.description: Add a parameter like TypeGuard[X, narrow_negative=True] to opt into both-branch narrowing.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Parameterized behavior on a type form is unusual in Python's type system and harder for type checkers to implement consistently.

objections.text: TypeIs and TypeGuard are easy to confuse. Having two similar but subtly different type narrowing mechanisms increases cognitive load.
